resume_protocol: Fetch latest main SHA, PR exact head, changed files/diff, CI and this checkpoint before any action.
Treat only committed code with passing tests as completed; never infer completion from chat history.
If main moved, compare and reconcile explicitly; never force-reset or overwrite unverified work.
Do not reintroduce subtree:true broad MutationObserver or documentElement-wide observers.
After this checkpoint commit, do not change functional code unless final-head CI fails or a release-blocking defect is found.
product_principle: 分享页首先是可连续阅读的考试坐标报告，不是排名海报；字号、留白、色差共同建立层级，不靠超大数字压住页面。

S1.name: Typography hierarchy
S1.evidence: 姓名桌面30px；主坐标桌面clamp(38px,4.4vw,44px)，手机36px，<=380px为34px；次级坐标19/17px；六科26/23px。

S2.name: Compact coordinate summary
S2.evidence: v42CompactRank 将第7名语义化为校第 7 名；班排名和总分进入同一坐标组；考试名称/日期排在坐标前。

S3.name: Reduce redundant labels
S3.evidence: v0.4.2 CSS 在 JS 前隐藏旧 学校相对位置 小标题；保留用户主动分享的身份字段，不新增内部标识输出。

S4.name: Subject density
S4.evidence: PC 六科保持3x2无卡片镀铬，单元最小92px；<=620px变为六行 compact row，最小52px。

S5.name: Surface and width
S5.evidence: 当前坐标继续浅品牌绿；六科区域降为白色；public-shell max-width=960px。

S6.name: Responsive and weak-network behavior
S6.evidence: CSS 直接覆盖 v41 既有 DOM，因此慢网无需等待 v42 JS 即可限制主排名<=44px并切换移动端六行；无页面级新增横向滚动。

S7.name: Regression and release
S7.evidence: 版本0.4.2已统一；v042 UI contract 已覆盖字号、语义、六科密度、移动端、observer guard；功能 head bb4bba2dd1a648dec26837f373ccf8138b5c870b CI run 34164373582 success。最终 checkpoint head 仍需再次 CI 后才允许 Ready/merge。
